Subject: Synthesis: Nora Bell — panel divergence and quick justification asks

Hi all,

Thanks for taking time on Nora's loop today. I collected the scorecards attached — we have five submitted but two came in late and one shows a pretty wide spread (4 -> 9). Before we lock, can folks do two quick things?

1) If you haven't uploaded a full scorecard yet, please drop it into this thread or the attached PDF within 24 hours.
2) If your numeric score differs from the panel median by >=2 points, please add 1-2 bullets of rationale (anchor examples are great).

Why: hiring manager wants a short synthesis to decide whether to move to final on-site. We should capture evidence for any outliers rather than guessing.

Attachments: NoraBell_scorecard.pdf (panel submissions so far)

Thanks — Mina

--

Thanks Mina — quick input from me: score = 8/10.
- Strengths: systems design depth on long-context KV cache, clear tradeoffs on batching/latency. Gave specific examples when asked about degraded tail latency mitigation.
- Concerns: limited production experience with model rollout policies and A/B rollback playbooks (asked but got high-level answers).

Attached: lauren_notes.txt (2 bullets + example prompts where Nora's reasoning worked).

Happy to expand if folks want a short anchor example for the final synth.

— Lauren

Action items:
- Priyom, Logan: please drop your completed scorecards or a 1-2 bullet justification if your score differs by >=2 points from the current median. Prefer EOD tomorrow so I can synthesize for hiring.
- Mina: can you confirm whether Jimothy should hold the final scheduling until we confirm synthesis? My preference is to get the extra anchors before finalizing but if the hiring manager wants to go ahead, call it out.

Attached: panel_consolidation.csv (raw scores + timestamps).

Tentative recommendation: proceed to final loop if no additional red flags come in; otherwise, paste anchors into the Google doc and we'll triage. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ABC12345panel-synthesis
